fullPassage: The idea of security can be considered to be one of the most fundamental of animal instincts. Every animal needs to feel secure and protecting from predators. The very existence of a species can be threatened if it cannot identify threats, communicate them to others in the species, and eventually develop a mechanism to challenge the threat. In the case of animals, there is a process of constant watchfulness to examine the surroundings and is aware of the presence of others in the space. Biologists have spent time studying the ways in which many birds and primates are able to keep an eye on their habitat, and when a threat is observed, the animals use a special kind of signal to communicate information about the danger to other animals in the space. This process has received scientific attention because it signals a level of cognition that can offer ways of understanding how animals communicate with each other. The key issue is that gaining a sense of security is an instinct that could be essential for the continued existence of a species.

❌ ③: 앞 문장이 종의 위협, 뒤 문장이 경계 과정이므로 중간에 생존 의존성 문장은 어색.
❌ ④: 생물학자 연구 내용 앞에 생존 의존성은 흐름 단절.
det.tip: In other words = 다시 말해. 앞 내용을 바꿔 말하는 역할.

questions.passage: The idea of security can be ①<u>considered</u> to be one of the most fundamental of animal instincts. Every animal needs to feel secure and protecting from predators. The very existence of a species can be threatened if it cannot identify threats, communicate them to others in the species, and eventually develop a mechanism to challenge the threat. In the case of animals, there is a process of constant watchfulness to examine the surroundings and is aware of the presence of others in the space. Biologists have spent time studying the ways in which many birds and primates are able to keep an eye on their habitat, and when a threat is observed, the animals use a special kind of signal to ②<u>communicate</u> information about the danger to other animals in the space. This process has received scientific attention because it signals a level of cognition ③<u>what</u> can offer ways of understanding how animals communicate with each other. The key issue is that ④<u>gaining</u> a sense of security is an instinct that could be essential for the continued existence of a species.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① considered: can be + 과거분사(수동태) — 적절.
❌ ② communicate: to + 동사원형(부정사) — 적절.
✅ ③ what: 선행사 cognition이 있으므로 관계대명사 that/which가 와야 함. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사(= the thing which)라 선행사와 함께 쓸 수 없음. what → that. ← 정답
❌ ④ gaining: 동명사 주어 — 적절.
det.tip: 선행사 있음 → that/which. 선행사 없음 → what. a level of cognition(선행사) + that(관계대명사).

det.analysis:
✅ T: 원문 'This process has received scientific attention because it signals a level of cognition' — 인지 수준을 나타내기 때문에 과학적 관심을 받았다. 정확히 일치.
❌ F: 원문과 일치하므로 부적절.

det.analysis:
❌ ① Biologists have spent time studying...: 원문 그대로. 적절.

✅ ③ ...because they signal a level of cognition...: 원문은 'it signals'. 주어가 This process(단수)이므로 it signals가 올바름. they signal → it signals. ← 정답
❌ ④ The key issue is that gaining...: 원문 그대로. 적절.
det.tip: This process(단수) → it(단수 대명사) + signals(3인칭 단수). they(복수)는 수 불일치.
